Pratik Damke

n Pratikdamke22@gmail.com | n +91-9309511294 | n India

Profile Summary Generative AI Engineer with hands-on experience in RAG modeling, LLM application development, and AI infrastructure integration. Specialized in LangChain, LangGraph, and AWS Bedrock with a strong background in semantic search, vector databases, and enterprise Q&A; system design. Skilled in integrating Claude, OpenAI, and Bedrock models into production-ready environments. Strong foundation in Python scripting, data workflows, and cloud infra support for LLM applications.

Key Skills LLM & GenAI Frameworks: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), LangChain, LangGraph, Transformers Cloud & Infra: AWS (S3, Lambda, Bedrock, OpenSearch, API Gateway, IAM), Infra automation Vector Tech: Semantic Search, Context Similarity Search, Vector Databases (Pinecone, OpenSearch, FAISS) Programming & Integration: Python scripting, API development, Claude & Bedrock LLM integration Data & Analytics: SQL, Power BI, ETL, Tableau, Data Visualization Security & Governance: Guardium, Imperva, access control, compliance automation

Professional Experience MetLife – Generative AI Engineer (Jul 2023 – Present) (cid:127) Built enterprise-grade Q&A; platform using RAG pipelines with AWS Bedrock, OpenSearch, Lambda, LangChain, LangGraph. (cid:127) Integrated Claude LLM for high-quality contextual responses with semantic search. (cid:127) Designed modular infra-ready architecture for scalable GenAI deployments. (cid:127) Worked with security teams to align AI solutions with compliance standards. (cid:127) Automated deployment workflows using Python and AWS services.

IBM – Generative AI Engineer (Jun 2022 – Jun 2023 | Pune) (cid:127) Developed RAG-based assistants using LangChain, vector databases, and Transformer models. (cid:127) Integrated Claude and OpenAI LLMs with enterprise search. (cid:127) Implemented prompt engineering and context optimization to reduce hallucinations. (cid:127) Collaborated with infra team for secure, scalable model deployment on AWS.

VCare Corporation – Data Analyst (Jul 2020 – May 2022 | Noida) (cid:127) Built automated ETL pipelines to collect and clean data from multiple sources, reducing manual processing time by 60%. (cid:127) Developed KPI dashboards in Power BI and Tableau for business teams. (cid:127) Optimized SQL queries for faster reporting. (cid:127) Implemented Python data validation scripts to ensure quality and consistency.

Skylex Technology – Data Analyst (Jul 2019 – Jun 2020 | Pune) (cid:127) Built reusable data transformation scripts in Python and migrated legacy reports to Power BI. (cid:127) Worked closely with project managers to align reporting with business KPIs. (cid:127) Performed data audits and reconciliations improving reporting accuracy by 25%.

Key Projects Pharma Document Intelligence (RAG + AWS Bedrock + Claude) (cid:127) Designed and deployed an enterprise-grade Q&A; system to handle pharma regulatory and compliance documents using RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) on AWS. (cid:127) Implemented document chunking, vector embeddings, and semantic search using AWS OpenSearch + LangChain for faster and more accurate retrieval. (cid:127) Integrated Claude LLM on AWS Bedrock for generating context-aware answers from pharma documents. (cid:127) Automated ingestion of PDFs and metadata using AWS Lambda and S3 pipelines. (cid:127) Reduced manual query resolution time by 50% with instant retrieval of compliance and drug data.

(cid:127) Ensured security compliance with HIPAA standards and internal governance. (cid:127) Built modular architecture supporting multi-domain document types (policy, SOP, drug research, and safety data).

GenAI Q&A; Platform (RAG + AWS + Claude) – Built an enterprise chatbot using LangChain, LangGraph, Claude, and AWS Bedrock. Used semantic search with vector DBs to improve response precision and latency.

Policy Document Assistant – Developed a secure AI assistant for compliance documents using RAG + Bedrock + Claude integration, improving internal policy query handling by 40%.

Code Summarization Tool – Created an internal summarizer using Transformers + LangChain to generate human-readable code documentation.

Data Automation Pipelines – Automated KPI dashboards with Python and SQL to reduce manual reporting time.

Education B.E. in Computer Science Engineering – Sipna College of Engineering & Technology, Amravati Diploma in Computer Science Engineering – Dr. Panjabrao Deshmukh Polytechnic, Amravati

Certifications & Training Generative AI Specialization – DeepLearning.AI LangChain for LLM Application Development – DeepLearning.AI Prompt Engineering for LLMs – Databricks / DeepLearning.AI AWS Certified Machine Learning – Specialty (in progress) Claude LLM Integration & Advanced Prompting (self-learning) Oracle Certified MySQL Database Administrator IBM Guardium Data Protection Fundamentals Microsoft Azure Security Technologies (AZ-500) (in progress)

sections.label: Projects
sections.text:
Key Projects Pharma Document Intelligence (RAG + AWS Bedrock + Claude) (cid:127) Designed and deployed an enterprise-grade Q&A; system to handle pharma regulatory and compliance documents using RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) on AWS. (cid:127) Implemented document chunking, vector embeddings, and semantic search using AWS OpenSearch + LangChain for faster and more accurate retrieval. (cid:127) Integrated Claude LLM on AWS Bedrock for generating context-aware answers from pharma documents. (cid:127) Automated ingestion of PDFs and metadata using AWS Lambda and S3 pipelines. (cid:127) Reduced manual query resolution time by 50% with instant retrieval of compliance and drug data.
(cid:127) Ensured security compliance with HIPAA standards and internal governance. (cid:127) Built modular architecture supporting multi-domain document types (policy, SOP, drug research, and safety data).
GenAI Q&A; Platform (RAG + AWS + Claude) – Built an enterprise chatbot using LangChain, LangGraph, Claude, and AWS Bedrock. Used semantic search with vector DBs to improve response precision and latency.
Policy Document Assistant – Developed a secure AI assistant for compliance documents using RAG + Bedrock + Claude integration, improving internal policy query handling by 40%.
Code Summarization Tool – Created an internal summarizer using Transformers + LangChain to generate human-readable code documentation.
Data Automation Pipelines – Automated KPI dashboards with Python and SQL to reduce manual reporting time.
